intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri hands you a blank scrap of paper. There is tremendous ceremony.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “You are cordially invited to a conversation. There is no itinerary.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Whatever you’re wearing. Theme: none. Refreshments: also none.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: You check the back for an agenda. There isn’t one.

options.labelText: “I accept. I’ll try very hard not to bring a list.”
“Sure. Want to jot down a few jokes first, so it doesn’t drag?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “A few jokes. For the conversation with no itinerary.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She writes some on the back of the invitation. It isn’t blank anymore.
